def toggle_middle_bits(n):
    bits = n.bit_length()
    if bits <= 2:  # no middle bits to toggle
        return n
    # ones in every position except the MSB (bits-1) and the LSB (bit 0)
    mask = ((1 << (bits - 2)) - 1) << 1
    return n ^ mask

assert toggle_middle_bits(9) == 15
